aboutH2: Medical Detoxification at Medical Detox Ontario
intro: Medical detoxification, or medical detox, is an essential first step in recovering from drug or alcohol addiction. Alcohol withdrawal is a common life-threatening condition for recovering addicts, and it is also true for people getting addiction treatment. At Medical Detox Ontario, we have the utmost dedication to helping those with drug or alcohol addiction problems. With our top-quality medical detox programs, you can be sure to secure a healthier future. Our medical detox program provides a foundation upon which to build new and healthy habits.

Medical Detox Toronto is the detox service of 1000 Islands Addiction Treatment Centre, and the old medicaldetox.ca address now forwards to that centre's website. Despite the name, detox takes place at the centre's campus on the Thousand Islands Parkway in Mallorytown, about three hours east of Toronto. Canadian Addiction Treatment Centres took over the centre in 2023.

pillars.title: Convenient Location and VIP Travel Services
pillars.body: Medical Detox Ontario is located on the same campus as one of the most exclusive and successful treatment facilities in the province of Ontario and Canada. We are conveniently found 3 hours from the city of Toronto, 2 hours from Montreal, and 1.5 hours from Ottawa, providing easy access to medical detoxification services. Canadians travelling to the Detox Facility from other provinces or countries can easily fly into the Ottawa International Airport and then take advantage of an optional VIP valet service in partnership with the 1000 Islands Wellness & Treatment Centre.

pillars.title: Licensed Health Care at Medical Detox Ontario
pillars.body: Licensed medical supervision is the key part of detoxification. At Medical Detox Ontario, we put our clients in the hands of our caring and professional doctor and nursing team. Round-the-clock, 24/7 supervision and care ensure that you are safe as your body deals with withdrawal. We understand that the detoxification process can be tough, which is why we strive to make it as comfortable and stress-free as possible.

pillars.title: Characteristics of Detoxification Programs
pillars.body: No matter where you choose to initiate your recovery path, learning about the characteristics of detoxification programs allows you to find the program that best fits your needs. Medical Detox Ontario offers a comprehensive medical detox program that ensures the safety and comfort of our clients. We use the latest medical techniques and resources to help our clients recover in a supportive and compassionate environment. Our program is personalized to meet the unique needs of each client, ensuring that they receive the care and attention they need.

location.heading: Medical Detox Toronto in Mallorytown, Ontario
location.intro: Detox happens at the 1000 Islands campus on the St. Lawrence River at Mallorytown, in Leeds and Grenville, between Brockville (about 20 minutes east) and Gananoque (about 25 minutes west). Kingston is around 40 minutes away and Ottawa about an hour and a half, while the drive from Toronto along Highway 401 takes roughly 3 hours.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing, its own website and recovery.com. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Medical Detox Toronto cost?
faqs.a: Recovery.com puts medical detox here at an estimated $6,500 and up. The figure changes with the program and how long you stay, and the centre's own website does not publish prices. Ask admissions for the exact fee before you book.

Most people stay from a few days to a couple of weeks. The doctor sets the length after your assessment, based on your health and the substances you are coming off, and recovery.com gives a typical range of 5 to 14 days.

faqs.q: Is Medical Detox Toronto actually in Toronto?
faqs.a: No. Detox takes place at 853 Thousand Islands Parkway in Mallorytown, on the campus of 1000 Islands Addiction Treatment Centre. That is about 3 hours from Toronto by Highway 401, 40 minutes from Kingston and an hour and a half from Ottawa. The centre is open 24 hours, so call (855) 929-4045 before you travel.

It is the detox service of 1000 Islands Addiction Treatment Centre, and medicaldetox.ca now forwards to that centre's website. Canadian Addiction Treatment Centres took over ownership in 2023, and the centre earned CARF accreditation in August of that year.

Once you are medically cleared, you can move into the residential program on the same campus, with your own room, a primary counsellor and a treatment plan. When you go home, aftercare includes a support line you can call day or night, progress check-ins, education for your family and referrals to local support groups and therapists.

faqs.q: Is this a private, paid service? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, it is a private, fee-based service, and recovery.com lists it as private pay only. The centre asks you to bring your health card and any medical and prescription coverage cards when you are admitted. Check with your extended health plan about reimbursement before you arrive.
